service.description: A new pipeline of an organization (organizationPartyId in the caller's scope, a name, an optional current team of that organization, TEAM_UNAVAILABLE; from fromDate, now or later), or an existing pipeline's name, description, team, default flag or end (end, or thruDate now or later), naming the revision read (expectedRevision, REVISION_CHANGED). One default per organization: setting it clears the organization's other. The shared pipeline (no organization) is changed only by a caller of every organization's scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED); another organization's answers RECORD_UNAVAILABLE. A pipeline whose stages hold open deals is not ended (PIPELINE_IN_USE). Needs SALES_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED). Nothing is deleted.

A new stage of a pipeline (a name unique among its current stages, DUPLICATE_VALUE; a default probability from 0 to 100, PROBABILITY_INVALID; an order from 0 to 9999, SEQUENCE_INVALID, last when empty; whether the board folds it), or an existing stage's name, probability, order or fold flag, a move up or down among the pipeline's current stages (move), or its retirement (retire): a stage holding open deals (not Won or Lost) is retired only with reassignStageId, another current stage of the same pipeline (STAGE_IN_USE without it, STAGE_INVALID for another), to which each open deal moves, audit-logged; closed deals keep the retired stage. A change of an existing stage names the revision read (REVISION_CHANGED); a retired one is not changed (RECORD_ENDED). The pipeline's organization in the caller's scope (the shared pipeline: every organization's). Needs SALES_CONFIGURE. Never deleted.

parameter.name: moved
parameter.description: The open deals moved to reassignStageId

service.description: A new sales team of an organization in the caller's scope (an Organization party with the SalesTeam role, owned by the organization, its PrtSalesTeamOf row from fromDate, now or later; a name unique among its current teams, DUPLICATE_VALUE; managerPartyId, a person who works for the organization, MEMBER_INVALID, joins as its Manager), or a team's name or end (end, or thruDate now or later; its memberships end with it), naming the revision read (REVISION_CHANGED). Another organization's team answers RECORD_UNAVAILABLE. Needs SALES_CONFIGURE or SALES_TEAM_MANAGE (PERMISSION_DENIED). Nothing is deleted; a team grants no permission.

A person joins a team (partyId: a person who works for the team's organization, an agent or employee in effect, MEMBER_INVALID; roleTypeId SalesRepresentative, the default, or Manager) from fromDate, now or later (DATE_INVALID), until thruDate when given; a person has one membership of a team at a time (MEMBER_EXISTS). Or a membership ends (partyRelationshipId, its revision, thruDate now or later; one not started ends at its start). Changes access prospectively and rewrites no attribution. The team in the caller's scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Needs SALES_CONFIGURE or SALES_TEAM_MANAGE. Never deleted.

A new lead source (a moqui.basic.DataSource of a LEAD_SOURCE type, TYPE_INVALID; a name no lead source has, DUPLICATE_VALUE) offered to organizationPartyId from now; an existing source's name or type, by a caller whose scope covers every organization it is offered to (SOURCE_SHARED), naming its revision; or its offer to an organization of the caller's added (bind, from fromDate now or later; BINDING_EXISTS) or ended (unbind, thruDate now or later). A source is shared by the instance and never deleted; ending an offer leaves the records that name it. Needs SALES_CONFIGURE and the organization in the caller's scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

A new lost reason (a SalesLostReason value: a name no current reason has, DUPLICATE_VALUE; an order from 0 to 9999, last when empty), or a reason's name, order or end (end, or thruDate now or later), naming its revision. An ended reason stays on the records that hold it and is offered for no new one; never deleted. The reasons are the instance's, so a change needs every organization's scope (SALES_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS or a system administrator; ORGANIZATION_DENIED for a configurer of fewer: the user's call, impl-sales §4 Nov 13, built in P4). Needs SALES_CONFIGURE.

What an organization offers now, to any Sales reader of it (SALES_VIEW, SALES_TEAM_VIEW or SALES_REPORT_VIEW, PERMISSION_DENIED; the organization in their scope, ORGANIZATION_DENIED): the opportunity types (Lead, Opportunity), the outcomes, its pipelines in effect (its own and the shared one) with their current stages and its default, its current teams, the lead sources offered to it, the current lost reasons and the recurring plans (enumCode: months).

parameter.name: pipelines
parameter.description: salesPipelineId, pipelineName, organizationPartyId, shared, teamPartyId, teamName, isDefault, stages [{opportunityStageId, description, defaultProbability, sequenceNum, folded}]

service.description: An organization's settings as its configurer or team manager reads them (SALES_CONFIGURE or SALES_TEAM_MANAGE; the organization in their scope): its teams with their dated members (manager names, current count, each membership's state and revision); and for SALES_CONFIGURE the pipelines it is offered with their stages and each stage's open deals, the lead sources (offered there or not; the other organizations named when in the caller's scope, else "other organizations"), the lost reasons and the types; ended rows with includeEnded; and whether the caller may change each part (canConfigure, canManageTeams, canEditShared, a pipeline's canEdit, a source's canRename).

parameter.name: canEditReasons
parameter.description: P4: whether the caller may change the instance's lost reasons (every organization's scope)

service.description: The facts of a lead or opportunity that create#Opportunity and update#Opportunity take.

parameter.name: probabilityModeEnumId
parameter.description: SpmStage (the stage's default, the default) or SpmManual

service.description: The one scoped query of the board, list and calendar, Home and the palette (design §3, §12.1): the leads and opportunities of the caller's sales scope (an organization of it; the deals assigned to the caller or a team of theirs, or the organization's every deal for SALES_TEAM_VIEW), filtered by type, organization, owner (mine Y: the caller) or team, pipeline and stage, outcome (SalesOppOpen: not Won or Lost; closed; a status), close period, account, source and campaign, and text (name or id, ignoring case), paged in the query. Each row's names, stage, owner, team, source, next activity, stage age and revision (selectionKey: id@revision, for a batch); the totals of the whole filtered result by currency; the board's stage columns (the pipeline asked, when shared or of the scope, else the default organization's default pipeline, empty stages too). Needs a Sales read (PERMISSION_DENIED); an organization outside the scope is refused (ORGANIZATION_DENIED). An account the caller may not see is named nowhere.

parameter.name: statusId
parameter.description: SalesOppOpen, SalesOppWon, SalesOppLost or closed; empty for every one

parameter.name: totals
parameter.description: {currencyUomId, amount, amountText, count} over the whole result

service.description: OpportunityDetail's record as the caller may see it (SalesAccess.js opportunityOf), else opportunityFound false: its facts with names (an account the caller may not see unnamed), outcome, stage of its pipeline and the pipeline's stages, its people (owner, team, contacts, dated, ended ones too), competitors, activities (linked tasks), linked quotes and orders (an organization reader's, of the scope's sellers, until P7 and P11), revision, and what the caller may do (canEdit and canClose on an open deal, canReopen on a closed one, canQualify on an open lead).

parameter.name: intakes
parameter.description: P5: the lead's intakes (kindText, receivedText, the submitted name, organization, email and phone, blank once purged, utmText, verified, duplicate, purged)

service.description: A lead (typeEnumId SotLead: no account or stage needed) or an opportunity (SotOpportunity, the default: a current stage of its pipeline, the first by default; the pipeline one the organization uses, its default by default) of an organization of the caller's scope (the one named, else the active one, the scope's only one or the only one of it the caller works for; ORGANIZATION_DENIED), with a name (NAME_REQUIRED), an optional account of the organization or shared (another organization's RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) and contact (a person the caller may see), an owner (the caller by default; a person who works for the organization, OWNER_INVALID; another than the caller a member of one of their teams unless SALES_TEAM_MANAGE) and team (a current team of the organization, the owner's only one by default; TEAM_UNAVAILABLE), the probability (the stage's default in Stage mode, the default, or the value given in Manual), amounts in a currency (the organization's base currency by default), close date, recurring amount and plan, a lead source offered to the organization (SOURCE_INVALID) and a campaign. Outcome Open. The organization, owner, team and contact are dated SalesOpportunityParty rows. Needs SALES_OPPORTUNITY_EDIT and a Sales read (PERMISSION_DENIED).

An open deal's facts, each given field changed and an empty one cleared (the name and a qualified deal's account kept: NAME_REQUIRED, ACCOUNT_REQUIRED): a value of estimatedProbability is the rep's (Manual mode) unless probabilityModeEnumId SpmStage copies the stage's default. Checked as create#Opportunity's. Names the revision read (REVISION_CHANGED); a closed deal is refused (RECORD_CLOSED); a deal the caller does not see answers RECORD_UNAVAILABLE. Needs SALES_OPPORTUNITY_EDIT.

An open deal to a current stage of its pipeline, or of another pipeline the organization uses (salesPipelineId), STAGE_INVALID otherwise: the stage's default probability copied in Stage mode only (a Manual value kept), the stage's entry dated, the move audit-logged with its note. A stage move is no closure (a closed deal RECORD_CLOSED). Names the revision read (REVISION_CHANGED). Needs SALES_OPPORTUNITY_EDIT on a deal the caller sees.

An open deal's outcome (statusId SalesOppWon or SalesOppLost, STATUS_INVALID): Lost needs a current lost reason (REASON_REQUIRED, REASON_INVALID), a lead's disqualification; the close date (now by default) and the actor, the note in the audit log. Won needs no order. Names the revision read. Needs SALES_OPPORTUNITY_EDIT.

A closed deal open again (an open one RECORD_OPEN) with the reason (REASON_REQUIRED), audit-logged beside the close it undoes, and optionally a current stage of its pipeline and a new expected close: the outcome, lost reason and close date cleared, the close history kept in the audit log. Names the revision read. Needs SALES_OPPORTUNITY_EDIT.

An open lead promoted, atomically, as the same record (salesOpportunityId kept): its account (one given, of the organization or shared, another organization's RECORD_UNAVAILABLE; or a new prospect accountName through mantle.sales.AccountServices.create#Account; or the lead's own; ACCOUNT_REQUIRED), its contact (a person given, made a contact of the account; or a new one named), a current stage of its pipeline, its owner, amount and close; the type Opportunity, the conversion time and actor, audit-logged; the source, activities, files and joins kept. An operation key (operationKey, OPERATION_KEY_REQUIRED) answers a retry with the first result (alreadyApplied), never a second account; the key used for another request is refused (OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT). An opportunity is refused (ALREADY_QUALIFIED). Names the revision read. Needs SALES_OPPORTUNITY_EDIT (and SALES_ACCOUNT_EDIT to create or join an account's contact).

A deal's people, dated and never deleted (roleTypeId: SalesRepresentative, the one current primary owner, the previous one ended; SalesTeam, its one current team; Contact, several; ROLE_INVALID otherwise): a party added from now (checked as create#Opportunity's owner, team and contact), or with end a current team or contact row ended (an owner is replaced, never ended: OWNER_REQUIRED). The organization's row stays the services' own. Names the deal's revision read (its party rows' stamps are its revision). Needs SALES_OPPORTUNITY_EDIT on a deal the caller sees.

A competitor on a deal (an organization the caller may see, not internal: COMPETITOR_INVALID), its position (a SalesCompetitorPosition), strengths and weaknesses; remove takes it off. Names the deal's revision read, which the competitor rows are part of, so the change advances it. Needs SALES_OPPORTUNITY_EDIT on a deal the caller sees.

OpportunityBatch: each chosen deal on its own, in its own transaction, at the revision its key names (opportunityKeys: "salesOpportunityId@revision", find#Opportunities' selectionKey): move (to opportunityStageId, move#Opportunity), assign (to ownerPartyId, store#OpportunityParty) or lose (with lostReasonEnumId, close#Opportunity). A stale, refused or failed deal is named with its reason code and the others go on (results, successCount). OPERATION_INVALID for another operation, SELECTION_REQUIRED for none.

An activity on a deal: a Commons task (mantle.work.TaskServices.create#SimpleTask) assigned to the caller or a person who works for the deal's organization (OWNER_INVALID), due when given, linked to the deal by link#WorkEffortRecord (SalesOpportunityWorkEffort, the opportunity's own join), so it shows in the assignee's Today and calendar. Completing it neither qualifies nor closes the deal. Needs SALES_OPPORTUNITY_EDIT on a deal the caller sees.

Whether the caller sees a deal (SalesAccess.js opportunityOf: an organization of their sales scope, and the deal assigned to them or a team of theirs, or SALES_TEAM_VIEW) and may change it (SALES_OPPORTUNITY_EDIT): the record visibility of get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles for the opportunity and its files. A call with no user sees none.

A file of a deal (SalesOpportunityContent, the record files of get#RecordLinkInfo): the row, and the uploaded file saved through save#OpportunityContentFile. Needs SALES_OPPORTUNITY_EDIT on a deal the caller sees (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_DENIED).
Internal to create#OpportunityContent, which checks the caller: the file of a SalesOpportunityContent row of that deal.

return.message: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE: File ${salesOpportunityContentId} is not of deal ${salesOpportunityId}

actions.script: const fileStream = contentFile.getInputStream() try { docRr.putStream(fileStream) } finally { fileStream.close() }

service.description: An inquiry as a lead (design §3 Leads, X16), from a validated source: a mail rule (create#LeadFromEmail), a Comms action on a mail or chat message or a voicemail, a staff entry, or Marketing's lead rules (impl-marketing P13). Writes a SalesLeadIntake with what the inquirer submitted (name, organization, email, phone; never on the deal, never a party: the party is made at qualification), the UTM pair, campaign, tracking code and verification; sets the lead's source by the organization's UTM map (source and medium over source alone; an unmapped pair keeps defaultDataSourceId, which must be offered to the organization, SOURCE_INVALID), its campaign (the tracking code's when none is given; CAMPAIGN_INVALID, TRACKING_INVALID) and a SalesOpportunityTracking row for the tracking code; and makes the lead, routed to the team queue the caller names. The duplicate policy: an open lead of the organization that an intake with the same submitted email made or joined is joined (duplicate, outcome SlioDuplicate, a review item on that lead), never merged. One source identity (sourceKind and sourceId) makes one intake, and a repeated operationKey answers the first result (alreadyApplied), whoever calls; another request under the key is OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT, a source already taken by another organization SOURCE_TAKEN. A user caller needs SALES_OPPORTUNITY_EDIT and the organization in their scope (PERMISSION_DENIED, ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and assigns as create#Opportunity does (themselves by default; TEAM_UNAVAILABLE, ASSIGNMENT_REQUIRED); a system caller (no user, or authorization disabled: the mail rule, Marketing's capture job) vouches for its source and names a current team of the organization (TEAM_REQUIRED, TEAM_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: sourceKind
parameter.description: formResponse, emailMessage, communicationEvent, chatMessage, voicemail or staff (or the SalesLeadIntakeSource enumId)

parameter.name: sourceId
parameter.description: The source's identity (a form response, a mail's Message-ID, a communication event, chatRoomId:eventSeq, a voicemail); a staff entry has none and needs operationKey

parameter.name: verified
parameter.description: The inquirer verified the email (Marketing's confirmed submission): such an intake is never purged

parameter.name: defaultDataSourceId
parameter.description: The source when the UTM map has none for the pair (the publication's, the rule's or the team's)

parameter.name: teamPartyId
parameter.description: The team whose queue the lead goes to

service.description: The createLead action of the mail client's rules (EmailRuleAction ErActCreateLead, CX-MAIL-INTAKE): a received message to a sales team's plus-tag address (sales+leads@..., the team's SalesIntakePlusTag), or to the team the action's value names, becomes an intake of that team's organization through store#LeadIntake, in that team's queue: its sender's name and address as submitted, its subject the lead's name, its text the description, the team's SalesIntakeSource as the default source, and the message filed on the lead as evidence. The message's Message-ID is the source identity, so the same mail delivered twice makes one lead. A team is taken only when the rule's owner works for its organization (TEAM_UNAVAILABLE otherwise, the rule's failure). Mail from anyone makes an intake, never a party.

parameter.name: value
parameter.description: The team (partyId), or empty for the plus tag

service.description: An organization's UTM source map row (design §9 UtmSourceMap, X10): a new mapping of a UTM source and optionally its medium (lower-cased, at most 60 characters; UTM_SOURCE_REQUIRED) to a lead source offered to the organization (SOURCE_INVALID), from fromDate now or later (DATE_INVALID); a current mapping of the same pair is ended first (MAPPING_EXISTS); or a mapping ended (salesLeadSourceMapId with end or thruDate now or later), naming its revision (REVISION_CHANGED). Ended, never changed or deleted. Needs SALES_CONFIGURE and the organization in the caller's scope (another organization's mapping answers RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

An organization's UTM source map for its configurer (SALES_CONFIGURE, the organization in the scope): each current row (with includeEnded the ended ones too) with its source's name, dates and revision.

A sales team's intake address (design §3 Leads, CX-MAIL-INTAKE): its plus tag (mail to sales+tag@ the intake mailbox, with a rule whose action is createLead, lands in the team's queue; letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore, TAG_INVALID; one team's, TAG_TAKEN) and its default lead source (offered to the team's organization, SOURCE_INVALID), as PartySettings of the team; empty clears either. Needs SALES_CONFIGURE and the team's organization in the caller's scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise).
An organization's current teams with their intake plus tag, address text and default lead source, for its configurer (SALES_CONFIGURE, the organization in the scope).

A call on a deal (design §1.4 Comms hooks: "Log call on opportunity" from a call or a voicemail): a Phone communication event of the caller, in from or out to one of the deal's current contacts when one is named (CONTACT_UNAVAILABLE otherwise), when it was (not ahead: DATE_INVALID), how long (0 to 1440 minutes: DURATION_INVALID) and what it was about (SUMMARY_REQUIRED), filed on the deal's conversation. Needs SALES_OPPORTUNITY_EDIT on a deal the caller sees (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Changes no field of the deal, so it names no revision.

The purge of design §3 Leads (X15): the submitted name, organization, email and phone of each unverified intake received more than retentionDays ago (30 until Sales' defaults set them, P9) whose lead never qualified, blanked with its purgedDate; a qualified or verified one is kept. The intake row, its source identity and key stay, so a retry still answers one lead. The ServiceJob purge_SalesLeadIntakes runs it nightly for every organization; a user needs SALES_CONFIGURE and purges the organizations of their scope. Each intake on its own: one that fails is logged and the rest go on.
